INFO.name: QUERY
INFO.value: SELECT TOP 999 VIDEOID,IAUNAME,FIELDNAME,RA2000,DEC2000,Z_MAG_APER_3,Z_MAGERR_APER_3,Y_MAG_APER_3,Y_MAGERR_APER_3,J_MAG_APER_3,J_MAGERR_APER_3,H_MAG_APER_3,H_MAGERR_APER_3,KS_MAG_APER_3,KS_MAGERR_APER_3,Z_FLAGS,Y_FLAGS,J_FLAGS,H_FLAGS,KS_FLAGS FROM VIDEO_CAT_DR5 WHERE RA2000 >= 52.931224363898 AND RA2000 <= 52.937891030565 AND DEC2000 >= -28.047884931580 AND DEC2000 <= -28.041218264914

FIELD.name: VIDEOID
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Unique identifier of object

FIELD.name: IAUNAME
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: IAU Name (not unique)

FIELD.name: FIELDNAME
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: the name of the pointing e.g. B418

FIELD.name: RA2000
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ICRS Right Ascension of object, calibrated using 2MASS

FIELD.name: DEC2000
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: ICRS Declination of object, calibrated using 2MASS

FIELD.name: Z_MAG_APER_3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Z band 3 arcsec diameter circlular aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: Z_MAGERR_APER_3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in Z band 3 arcsec diameter circlular aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: Y_MAG_APER_3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Y band 3 arcsec diameter circlular aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: Y_MAGERR_APER_3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in Y band 3 arcsec diameter circlular aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: J_MAG_APER_3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: J band 3 arcsec diameter circlular aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: J_MAGERR_APER_3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in J band 3 arcsec diameter circlular aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: H_MAG_APER_3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: H band 3 arcsec diameter circlular aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: H_MAGERR_APER_3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in H band 3 arcsec diameter circlular aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: KS_MAG_APER_3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Ks band 3 arcsec diameter circlular aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: KS_MAGERR_APER_3
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error in Ks band 3 arcsec diameter circlular aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: Z_FLAGS
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: SExtractor flags for Z image objects

FIELD.name: Y_FLAGS
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: SExtractor flags for Y image objects

FIELD.name: J_FLAGS
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: SExtractor flags for J image objects

FIELD.name: H_FLAGS
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: SExtractor flags for H image objects

FIELD.name: KS_FLAGS
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: SExtractor flags for Ks image objects
